description: This header file defines the main engine configuration data structure and associated functions for managing engine parameters such as fuel maps, ignition timing, operation modes, and configuration data persistence. It includes function prototypes for setting and retrieving engine configuration settings, as well as macros and include directives relevant to engine configuration management.

methods.name: getRpmMultiplier
methods.description: Returns the RPM multiplier based on the current operation mode.

methods.name: setOperationMode
methods.description: Sets the engine operation mode in the configuration structure.

methods.name: prepareVoidConfiguration
methods.description: Prepares an empty or default engine configuration.

methods.name: setDefaultConfiguration
methods.description: Sets default engine configuration parameters.

methods.name: setTargetRpmCurve
methods.description: Sets the RPM curve target values.

methods.name: setAfrMap
methods.description: Sets the Air-Fuel Ratio (AFR) map.

methods.name: setMap
methods.description: Sets fuel map parameters.

methods.name: setWholeFuelMap
methods.description: Applies a uniform value to the entire fuel map.

methods.name: setWholeIgnitionIatCorr
methods.description: Sets the ignition timing correction based on Intake Air Temperature.

methods.name: setFuelTablesLoadBin
methods.description: Configures fuel table load bounds.

methods.name: setWholeIatCorrTimingTable
methods.description: Sets the entire IAT correction timing table.

methods.name: setWholeTimingTable_d
methods.description: Sets the entire timing table with a specified angle.

methods.name: setWholeTimingTable
methods.description: Wrapper to set the whole timing table.

methods.name: setConstantDwell
methods.description: Sets the ignition dwell time.

methods.name: printFloatArray
methods.description: Prints an array of floats with a prefix.

methods.name: setDefaultBasePins
methods.description: Sets default base pins configurations.

methods.name: setDefaultSerialParameters
methods.description: Initializes default serial communication parameters.

methods.name: setDefaultSdCardParameters
methods.description: Configures default SD card parameters.

methods.name: rememberCurrentConfiguration
methods.description: Saves the current configuration as active.

methods.name: incrementGlobalConfigurationVersion
methods.description: Increments the global configuration version counter.

methods.name: getGlobalConfigurationVersion
methods.description: Retrieves the current global configuration version.

methods.name: commonFrankensoAnalogInputs
methods.description: Configures analog inputs for Frankenso engine controller.

methods.name: setFrankenso0_1_joystick
methods.description: Initializes joystick input for Frankenso.

methods.name: copyTargetAfrTable
methods.description: Copies source AFR table to destination.

methods.name: copyFuelTable
methods.description: Copies source fuel map to destination.

methods.name: copyTimingTable
methods.description: Copies source ignition timing table to destination.
